name: Screen frame (taskbar insets)
plain: Offsets between full screen and usable area reveal taskbar or dock size and position.
meaning: Shows macOS dock height and side, Windows taskbar edge, notches and system bars. Identifies OS UI settings and multi-monitor layout. Firefox now hides taskbar size by default.

web.api: screen.availTop, availLeft, availWidth, availHeight vs width, height

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

limits.headline: Can tell how big your taskbar or dock is and where it sits
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads.
can: Compare the full screen size with the usable area
Guess your operating system and dock position
Add the result to a browser fingerprint
cannot: See which apps are on your dock or taskbar
See your other monitors without the multi-screen permission

story.what_it_is: The gap between your full screen and its usable area reveals where your taskbar or dock sits.

marketing.name: Screen availWidth
marketing.pitch: Documents the width of the screen not taken by system bars like the taskbar.

story.for_you: You never see it. The page subtracts two numbers and learns how big your taskbar or dock is and which side it is on.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to place popups and windows without hiding them under a taskbar. Trackers like it because taskbar size and side is a rare mix that helps spot your computer again.

use_cases.example: A browser game opens a pop out window sized to fit above the taskbar.
A web app places a floating panel so that the dock does not cover it.
A fraud check sees a screen frame that does not match the claimed operating system and flags it as a spoofed device.
A fingerprint script reads the taskbar gap as one more way to separate your computer from others with the same screen.
A team learns how much usable height they have on typical laptops.
A kiosk or signage page can tell it is not running in a normal desktop mode.

history.change: Taskbar and dock size hidden by default
